data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that scrolls text and other widgets with RTL support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Marquee widget that scrolls text and other widgets horizontally or vertically. It supports various customizations like custom scroll directions, velocities, durations, curves, and pausing after rounds.
use_when: You need to display overflowing text or custom widgets inside a scrolling marquee animation.
You require right-to-left (RTL) text scrolling support.
avoid_when: You need standard static layout or traditional scrollable lists and grids.
strengths: Supports scrolling arbitrary widgets, not just text.
Customizable scroll directions, velocities, durations, and curves.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic examples.
Marquee animations can sometimes be visually distracting if overused.
